status_at_baseline: **RESOLVED 2026-09-01, and the answer is no.** Measured live against the endpoint `claude-swap` uses: `GET https://api.anthropic.com/api/oauth/usage`, bearer from the macOS Keychain (service `Claude Code-credentials` → `claudeAiOauth.accessToken`; on macOS it is NOT in `~/.claude/.credentials.json`), header `anthropic-beta: oauth-2025-04-20`. HTTP 200. It returns `five_hour.utilization: 46.0` with `resets_at`, `seven_day.utilization: 17.0`, per-model `seven_day_opus`/`seven_day_sonnet`, and `extra_usage {monthly_limit, used_credits, currency}`. **`limit_dollars`, `used_dollars` and `remaining_dollars` all came back `None`** on this plan, and nothing in the response is per-session or per-project. So: **the per-project cost cell has no source and is dropped** — not zero, not a dash, absent. What exists instead is an ESTATE-level quota reading, which is M83 and is arguably the more useful number. Three caveats recorded with it: the endpoint is undocumented and internal to the Claude Code client, so it must degrade by showing the last-known value WITH ITS AGE rather than a stale number as current; reading it means the app now holds an OAuth token that can act as the operator, which must never be logged (M81 redaction), must go nowhere but `api.anthropic.com`, and must be disclosed in the interface; and polling must back off and honour `Retry-After`
